case_number: 2024 INSC 995; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 5387 OF 2024 [ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL) NO. 9209 OF 2024]
summary: Bail plea in terror case; charges under IPC 121/121A/153A/153B and UAPA 13/17/18/18A/20; appellant claims fabricated evidence regarding 2047 Islamic rule document; alleged raid location mismatch; NIA re-registered case post-PFI ban; contention: no terrorist act evidence, mere protest participation; reference to co-accused bail; trial pending over 28 months; prosecution cites CCTV, call records, protected witnesses; HC denial overturned.
legal_provisions_cited: Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act 1967 s.13, s.17, s.18, s.18A, s.18B, s.20
final_judgment: Bail granted; High Court order set aside; appellant ordered released from custody.
